title: Candy Island Match
description: Journey across a sunlit tropical archipelago matching colorful candies, crafting striped and rainbow boosters, and clearing handcrafted island stages.
controls: Select a level on the island map, then swipe adjacent candies to match three or more and combine special boosters.

zh-CN.title: 糖果消消乐
zh-CN.description: 沿着碧海阳光热带岛屿地图一路闯关，滑动消除缤纷糖果，合成条纹糖与彩虹炸弹引爆全屏特效。
zh-CN.controls: 点击岛屿地图关卡开局，滑动交换相邻糖果凑成三连或四五连合成超级特效糖果过关。
